acceptanceCriteria.text: Production creation of the canonical Runtime Appliance uses Lima plain mode through the documented/public `limactl` interface.
Regression coverage verifies the exact production create arguments include the required plain-mode behavior.
The fix does not add cloud-init, Lima cidata boot scripts, or another Lima-specific semantic fork to the canonical NixOS Appliance.
Once SSH is reachable, Route 3 proceeds to Mottainai's canonical `mottainai-runtime-health` readiness boundary instead of waiting for `/run/lima-ssh-ready`.
The behavior remains compatible with bounded mounts, QEMU/KVM binding, restart/reconcile, and managed-generation convergence.
#840 plus this fix is sufficient for a real Lima-created canonical Appliance to advance past provider SSH/readiness into Mottainai guest-health evaluation.

issue.title: fix(runtime): create canonical NixOS Lima instances in plain mode
